_readme: Facts the scanner cannot see. size_overrides change the modulus size only when 'confirmed' is true. 'projects' holds per-project facts used by the CBOM. 'experiments' are results from local small-key copies, which are NOT the projects of record and are never attached to a CBOM entry.

set.size_basis: generate_keypair(bits=128) gives a 256-bit modulus (app.py:239, 385; main.py:101). The bits=256 default in rsa_utils.py (512-bit modulus) is only a default and is not used.
generate_small_keypair() gives n < 256, so at most 8 bits (callers pass no argument, so max_n=256)
user-selectable: the UI selectbox offers 1024, 2048 and 3072 with 2048 as the UI default (index=1); the function default is 1024

size_overrides.source: Tarun and Vaibhav (UI selectbox in the video project)

set.size_basis: generate_small_keypair() call site: n < 256, so at most 8 bits (callers pass no argument, so max_n=256)
generate_small_keypair() call site: n < 256, so at most 8 bits (callers pass no argument, so max_n=256)

padding.weakness: Deterministic encryption: the same plaintext always gives the same ciphertext, so there is no semantic security. This is a classical weakness, independent of Shor's algorithm.
padding.source: Vaibhav: textbook RSA with no padding, confirmed by hand (edge_flag NO_PADDING)

size_notes: Two real key paths: generate_keypair(bits=128) gives a 256-bit modulus (app.py:239, 385; main.py:101), and generate_small_keypair() in the R-channel module gives n < 256 (at most 8 bits). The 512-bit default in rsa_utils.py is not used.

padding.weakness: Deterministic encryption: the same plaintext always gives the same ciphertext, so there is no semantic security. This is a classical weakness, independent of Shor's algorithm.
padding.source: Vaibhav: textbook RSA with no padding, confirmed by hand (edge_flag NO_PADDING)

size_notes: Key size is user-selectable: the UI offers 1024, 2048 and 3072 bits with 2048 as the UI default; the function default is 1024. A user who picks 1024 gets a key below the 2048-bit minimum.

experiments.target: local small-key snapshot (Vaibhav's ZIP copy of the image project, whose generate_keypair defaults to bits=16); not the project of record
experiments.description: Image steganography attack end to end: extract the ciphertext, factor n, decrypt.

experiments.target: local small-key snapshot (video_stego_project_updated, reduced key made with generate_keypair(key_size=96)); not the project of record
experiments.description: Video steganography attack at a reduced key. It does not need the secret frame key: it scans for the 16-bit length header.
